answer: To secure an economy of autonomous agents against Sybil attacks, networks can employ a cryptographic reputation staking model utilizing colored tokens like sable, onyx, and yarrow to denote distinct verification tiers. An attacker attempting to flood the network with fake identities must lock up substantial cryptographic collateral for each node. The economic cost scales linearly with the number of generated identities, rendering decentralized exploitation financially unviable due to capital lockup and slashing risks.
